meta.Syllabus Name: Software development project_Dự án phát triển phần mềm
meta.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture, Lab, Group Discussion, Presentation, Peer Review.AI-integrated tasks across all Software Development Life Cycle phases
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h Project Presentation + 104h self-study
meta.Pre-Requisite: PRJ301, SWE201c or SWE202c, pass LAB211
meta.Description: This course guides students through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by working on a real-world team project, with an emphasis on applying AI responsibly in requirement analysis, design, implementation, and testing. Students will practice user story writing, system design, coding using MVC and OOP, workflow development, testing, and reporting. AI tools are integrated into each phase to enhance productivity and quality.
meta.StudentTasks:
- Join the team as arranged by the teacher
- Select the project topic & technology stack and get approval from teacher before implementing
- Attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final presentation.
- Analyze requirements, write user requirements, and create system diagrams with AI-assisted tools.
- Design system architecture, database schema, and UI/UX wireframes using MVC, OOP, and AI suggestions.
- Implement core features with AI-supported coding, apply coding standards, and manage source code in Git.
- Develop and run unit/integration tests, using AI to suggest and refine test cases.
- Deploy the application to staging, verify functionality, and prepare for final delivery.
- Manage project progress, present milestones, and prepare high-quality reports with AI support.
meta.Tools:
- Requirement & Design: Miro, Lucidchart, Figma, Draw.io, ChatGPT, Gemini
- Coding & Debugging: IntelliJ IDEA / VS Code / Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot, Tabnine
- Database: MySQL Workbench, SQL Server Management Studio, pgAdmin
-Testing: JUnit, NUnit, Postman, Selenium, AI-powered test case generators
- Project Management: Jira, Trello, Notion, Git/GitHub
- Deployment: Docker, Heroku, AWS / Azure / GCP, Vercel

chunks.subject_name: Software development project_Dự án phát triển phần mềm
chunks.text:
Description: This course guides students through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by working on a real-world team project, with an emphasis on applying AI responsibly in requirement analysis, design, implementation, and testing. Students will practice user story writing, system design, coding using MVC and OOP, workflow development, testing, and reporting. AI tools are integrated into each phase to enhance productivity and quality.
NoCredit: 3
Pre-Requisite: PRJ301, SWE201c or SWE202c, pass LAB211
Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h Project Presentation + 104h self-study
StudentTasks: - Join the team as arranged by the teacher
- Select the project topic & technology stack and get approval from teacher before implementing
- Attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final presentation.
- Analyze requirements, write user requirements, and create system diagrams with AI-assisted tools.
- Design system architecture, database schema, and UI/UX wireframes using MVC, OOP, and AI suggestions.
- Implement core features with AI-supported coding, apply coding standards, and manage source code in Git.
- Develop and run unit/integration tests, using AI to suggest and refine test cases.
- Deploy the application to staging, verify functionality, and prepare for final delivery.
- Manage project progress, present milestones, and prepare high-quality reports with AI support.
MinAvgMarkToPass: 5
